subject: general
question:
Match the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of India (declared between 2021 and 2024) in List I with their location states in List II and select the correct answer. 

 
 

 
 
**List I **

 
**(UNESCO World Heritage Sites)**

 
 
 
** List II **

 
**(States)**

 
 
 

 
 
1.

 
 Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple
 
 
(A)

 
 Telangana
 
 

 
 
2.

 
 Santiniketan, India
 
 
(B)

 
 West Bengal
 
 

 
 
3.

 
 Sacred Ensemble of Hoysalas
 
 
(C)

 
 Karnataka
 
 

 
 
4.

 
 Charaideo Moidam 
 
 
(D)

 
 Assam
solution:
The correct answer is __**3) 1 - A, 2 - B, 3 - C, 4 - D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple** is located in the state of **Telangana**. It was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021.
 
• **Santiniketan**, renowned for its association with Rabindranath Tagore and his Visva-Bharati University, is situated in **West Bengal**. It was inscribed in 2023.
 
• The **Sacred Ensemble of Hoysalas** is located in the state of **Karnataka**. This site was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2023.
 
• **Charaideo Moidam**, also known as the pyramids of Assam, is located in the state of **Assam**. It was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple** is known for its intricate craftsmanship and the use of lightweight floating bricks.
 
• **Santiniketan** was founded by Rabindranath Tagore and is a significant cultural and educational center in India.
 
• The **Sacred Ensemble of Hoysalas** includes the renowned Hoysaleswara and Chennakeshava temples, which are exemplary of Hoysala architecture.
 
• **Charaideo Moidam** consists of burial mounds and is a sacred site of the Ahom dynasty, reflecting their unique mortuary practices.
 
• UNESCO World Heritage Sites are designated for their cultural, historical, scientific, or other forms of significance, and they are legally protected by international treaties.
